articles.summary: 15-Year Sinclair Veteran to Lead KBOI, KYUU and KNIN BOISE, Idaho – November 2, 2026 – Sinclair today announced the promotion of Jennifer Lopez to Vice President and General Manager of KBOI, KYUU and KNIN in Boise, Idaho, effective immediately. articles.title: Sinclair Names Jennifer Lopez to Vice President and General Manager of Boise Television Stations
